inputs.name: cycle_irregularity_90d
inputs.description: Standard deviation of cycle length (days between cycle starts, requires >=3 starts) over the last 90 days.

inputs.name: androgenic_symptoms
inputs.description: Any reported androgenic symptom (acne, excess hair) in the last 90 days.
